name: PvP Glory: an honorable killing blow on a player adds 1 Glory to the killer, kept and sent to the client
contract: The client's PvP panel (Ascension_PVP.lua PVPHonorLevelMixin) shows GetGloryPoints("player") as Glory and turns it into the Glory Rank through C_PVP:GetHonorRank (rank 2 at 250). Extensions.dll reads Glory from field 35 of the player's SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT_ADDON (0x0578) table. Ascension's Glory System: Glory is gained by landing killing blows in world PvP or battlegrounds and when the team completes battleground objectives, more for objectives. This fork awards 1 Glory per killing blow that counts as an honorable kill and 5 per objective; Glory is never spent and is stored per character in the player setting core.coa_glory. A level 60 killer's grey level is 60 - 9 = 51, so killing a level 50 player is not an honorable kill and adds no Glory, while killing a level 60 player of the other faction adds 1 Glory to the killer only. Each change sends the field to the client, and replaying the login keeps the stored Glory.

steps.label: A new character starts without Glory
The killer lands the killing blow on the grey-level player
A killing blow that is not an honorable kill adds no Glory
The killer lands the killing blow on the level 60 rival
An honorable killing blow adds 1 Glory
The new Glory is sent to the client
The slain player gains no Glory
